name: Roselune
summary: Roselune reveals a seat wrapped in finely textured fabric, offering soft yet structured elegance. Slender brushed nickel legs in stainless steel lend a subtle gleam and contemporary refinement. With clean proportions and graceful presence, it captures the quiet allure of modern European design. 66x58x77
